Classified region.

Terrain opens a top-level h1 region "Spiny Moss Court" (block EewKdG2owoi9uNxNeGdco7jqnec) that nests the h2 sections Town Of Decaying Wood, Elftigern and Parasitic Cavity; Biology repeats it as a top-level creature h1 (block YCYwdeYPEomoMVxotFOcE8gZnUh). Classified region.

Terrain opens a top-level h1 region "Valley Of Lush And Moist" (block doxcnqyNVBoRDTYY1LgXk5uwHJb) with the nested h2 climber outpost; Biology repeats it as a top-level creature h1 (block WxatdnICsojUQoxS6VXcXeYgnwd); the overview sentence (block doxcnCoWSGexMstAlFUKqqvFoRg) names it among the layer subterrains. Classified region.

The overview sentence (block doxcnCoWSGexMstAlFUKqqvFoRg) names "Town of Decaying Wood" among the layer subterrains, but the strongest structural evidence is that its design section is an h2 (block FzR8d1wdfoIKcyxago0czMkVnFJ) nested under the Spiny Moss Court h1 (block EewKdG2owoi9uNxNeGdco7jqnec) rather than a peer top-level region. Classified nested_area (not folded into a peer region).

Only the overview sentence (block doxcnCoWSGexMstAlFUKqqvFoRg) names Green Tundra among the layer subterrains; it reappears only in the array-repair purification list (block doxcnj949SQHOWtZrrOmrvKBwyb). No h1-h6 heading for it exists in the terrain or biology outline, so no dedicated design section can be found; classification region is the strongest supported value and remains unconfirmed.

assumptions.text: Item-document table column order is assumed to be name, texture (artwork), code, ... for every item table, so the parser resolves artwork/code by header name rather than cell position. The committed snapshot is header-anchored, but a table without a resolvable header could flip the two states.

Green Tundra is listed among the layer subterrains but has no dedicated design section; it is classified as region (strongest supported value) with resolved=false and a blocker. Affected geography and items must stay blocked until the label is confirmed.
assumptions.source: RESEARCH Open Question 1 / Assumptions Log A2

assumptions.text: Placeable classes with the _Item suffix may carry their display key under the item name or under the tile name (e.g. OldMoss exists while OldMoss_Item does not). Key-name resolution is deferred to the localization parity plan; no localization key is renamed or removed here.
assumptions.source: RESEARCH Open Question 3 / Assumptions Log A3

assumptions.text: An item whose class resolves to a shared texture (Commons.ModAsset.White_Mod / Point_Mod) with no local .png is recorded artwork-incomplete even when the Feishu texture checkbox is true (RadialCarapace). This is recorded as a yellow status with a blocker, not dropped.

Committed design rows expose no structured ingredient column, so entry dependencies are derived from repository AddRecipes() references to other Everglow items; unmatched entries keep an empty dependencies array. Dependencies are corroborating, not design-authored.
Item-design rows carry no region tag in the committed snapshot, so the label-to-entry mapping is left empty rather than fabricated; label reconciliation records classification and rationale only.
assumptions.source: plan 02 task 2 method / orchestrator instruction to record blockers rather than invent reconciliation data

assumptions.text: Rows whose design name is a bare placeholder (A, B, C) with only a generic "array repair material" description are marked deferred with an undefined-future reason; they remain in the inventory and are re-evaluated when the design is defined.
